content.text: {"summary":"Each matched pair of ReLU units 2/11 and 4/5 adds up to a linear term, contributing velocity slopes of about -0.29 and -0.415. Units 3 and 8 add small extra slopes. The velocity-only units 0, 1 and 6 only switch on for |v| above about 0.66, so they model the quadratic drag. The total linear damping is about c ≈ 0.72. The patch uses the unused units 12 and 13 as relu(v) and relu(-v) with output weights -c and +c. Together they add exactly -c*v everywhere, and all other behavior is unchanged.","estimated_c":0.72,"patches":[{"tensor":"W1","index":[12,1],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[13,1],"value":-1.0},{"tensor":"W2","index":[12],"value":-0.72},{"tensor":"W2","index":[13],"value":0.72}]}
